liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (4 reviews): Has the usual transition into I Know You Rider, placed before Easy Wind; the song title is mislabeled; A jam links China Cat and I Know You Rider [9][10][12][13]
- **Black Peter** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds this version wrenching; Black Peter through New Speedway Boogie is a splendid stretch [9][14]
- **How Long Blues** (2 reviews): A rare Garcia number; reviewer says it may be their only soundboard copy by the band; Reviewer notes it as a rare inclusion in the acoustic set [5][6]
- **New Speedway Boogie** (2 reviews): Extended jam with roughly three-minute outro closes the acoustic set; Features a nice jam, a favorite of the reviewer [5][6]
- **El Paso** (1 review): Before this song, Jerry jokes that Weir is about to get his wish at everyone else's expense [4]
- **Easy Wind** (1 review): The tape wasn't running at the start, so only a Garcia solo and Pigpen's last verse survive [4]

## Setlist highlights

- **How Long Blues**: rare: 5 archived performances [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1970-07-14.sbd.unknown.96628.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 135 min; rated 4.4/5 by 15 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls it a strong soundboard with classic 1970 sound; Sound quality has issues, though they preserve some funny banter; lyrical slip-ups also occur; The recording is split into four tracks, but Good Lovin' remains intact [4][9][10][13][14]
- **gd70-07-14.sbd.cotsman.17815.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 127 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Electric set suffers from mix problems and buzzing, while the acoustic set sounds good to this listener; A noticeable buzz runs throughout the recording [2][3]

## Around the show

- The acoustic set includes enjoyable stage banter between songs [3]
- David Crosby plays 12-string guitar on Cumberland Blues and New Speedway Boogie, with Jerry on electric [12]
- David Crosby joins on acoustic guitar for Cumberland Blues and New Speedway Boogie while Garcia plays electric [2]
- Show offers both a mellow acoustic set and a rocking psychedelic electric set [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1970-07-14.sbd.unknown.96628.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > Master Reel > Dat> cd> shn> cd> ?> shn [1]
- **gd70-07-14.sbd.cotsman.17815.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by JCotsman; source: Soundboard patched with Audience [2]. Also: Cumberland and New Speedway may be patched in from a different, later-generation source [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Euphoria Ballroom, San Rafael, Poster](https://www.dead.net/archives/1970/artwork/euphoria-ballroom-san-rafael-poster) [16]
- Poster by San Andreas Fault Grateful: [09 | December | 2017 | Original Concert Posters](https://original-concert-posters.com/2017/12/09/) [17]
